windchill_semantics: Explicit downstream destination/organisation target associated with publishable objects
nublox_benchmark: Integration endpoint/target must be governed identity

windchill_semantics: One ESI transaction represents publication to a downstream system instance
ReleaseActivity represents an individual object × target publication
Pending ReleaseActivity prevents duplicate concurrent publication to the same target
Downstream result is returned and persisted against publication activity/transaction
nublox_benchmark: Transport send is not equivalent to successful apply

windchill_semantics: Result includes object/action/target/transaction/success and diagnostic information
nublox_benchmark: Correlate integration evidence to exact object operation and target

windchill_semantics: Failed publication is corrected then republished from Windchill; old downstream transaction is not simply replayed
nublox_benchmark: Retry creates new governed attempt from current authoritative state

windchill_semantics: New transaction is created for failed downstream instances and data is sent only to failed targets
nublox_benchmark: Retry scope should preserve successful target outcomes

windchill_semantics: By default only objects changed since last successful attempt are republished
nublox_benchmark: Publication history participates in delta selection

windchill_semantics: Object and attribute authority is explicitly split between Windchill and downstream enterprise systems
nublox_benchmark: Authority must be explicit per object/attribute family

windchill_semantics: Published source objects are expected to remain version-aligned and not publish revisions out of order
nublox_benchmark: Enforce ordered publication where downstream semantics require it

windchill_semantics: Successful downstream publication does not inherently mean source mastership has transferred
nublox_benchmark: Authority transfer requires an explicit business rule/process
